_opening_ramp: Tier C (#307): whole-round opening multiplier; neutral tier-1 ramp preserves #293 pacing. HP captures at spawn; ordinary damage at impact; bosses capture both on arrival.
name: The Tree That Grew I
_bosses: Tier C (spec #447, ticket #452): no boss appears twice across the progression, so Ellinia takes the Mushroom Castle bosses and Faust: Prime Minister replaces Stumpy, Grey Yeti and King Pepe replaces King Slime, Faust replaces Dyle. Each matches the boss it replaces by the #254 method (effective HP, contact and attack damage at the slot's typical_hp/typical_pdd); the _tier notes show the derivations. Starting values, untuned. Canonical stats, attack boxes, timing and skill kits remain in Mob.wz.
_maps: Tier C: owner map order and pool rules, spec #241; bosses per spec #447 (ticket #452). Each boss time is relative to map entry. 101010100 The Tree That Grew I: Prime Minister (a Mushroom Castle boss; the map has no v83 boss of its own); 100040100 The Forest of Wisdom: Grey Yeti and King Pepe; 100040105 The Forest of Evil I: Faust (its own MonsterBook map).
